rule: sha256('<dataset>:<scan>')[0] % 2 === 0 -> development, else acceptance. A pure function of the name: no scan can be moved after results are seen.
protocol: Choose every parameter on development scans only.
Evaluate acceptance scans once per frozen configuration; report every acceptance scan, including the bad ones.
Never copy an acceptance scan into development, never re-roll the rule.
Licences are NOT asserted here: they are recorded in each scan's meta.json by whoever downloads the data, from the source page, and checked before any redistribution.

DTU.listProvenance: Standard DTU evaluation scans used by MVS benchmarks; list written from the public benchmark description, to be checked against the downloaded archive.
DTU.licence: UNVERIFIED — read the licence on the dataset page before download and record it in meta.json
DTU.access: NOT DOWNLOADED: outbound network policy of the build environment blocks the dataset hosts; see scripts/datasets/README.md
